door-guard.alt: The live view at the front door. The yellow rectangle is the configured door zone, and the overlay carries the running loiter timer, the current risk score, and the active mode. Presence alone is not an event; being inside that box for long enough is.
door-guard.caption: The live view at the front door. The yellow rectangle is the configured door zone, and the overlay carries the running loiter timer, the current risk score, and the active mode. Presence alone is not an event; being inside that box for long enough is.

door-guard.alt: One full cycle in the log. Audio is transcribed, risk escalates from medium to high, and a local model generates the spoken deterrent: "This is a residence, not a convenience store. Please come back tomorrow." Each risk snapshot is written with its timestamp and level, and the five failed frame reads at the bottom are the reconnect logic doing its job rather than the process dying.

linkage-larry.alt: Where the project starts: the toe trace over one full crank rotation, solved in Python by breaking the linkage into dyads. The flat lower edge is the stance phase, the arch above it the swing. Get this curve wrong and nothing downstream matters.
linkage-larry.caption: Where the project starts: the toe trace over one full crank rotation, solved in Python by breaking the linkage into dyads. The flat lower edge is the stance phase, the arch above it the swing. Get this curve wrong and nothing downstream matters.

linkage-larry.alt: The same solver carried through to velocity, acceleration, and vertical load capacity. Load drops to zero exactly where the foot leaves the ground, which is the check that the model matches the gait.
linkage-larry.caption: The same solver carried through to velocity, acceleration, and vertical load capacity. Load drops to zero exactly where the foot leaves the ground, which is the check that the model matches the gait.

linkage-larry.alt: The verified geometry taken into CAD: six legs on a shared crankshaft per side, phase-offset so ground contact stays continuous.
linkage-larry.caption: The verified geometry taken into CAD: six legs on a shared crankshaft per side, phase-offset so ground contact stays continuous.

linkage-larry.alt: Coarse-mesh FEA on a single eight-bar leg in laminate plywood, before committing to material.
linkage-larry.caption: Coarse-mesh FEA on a single eight-bar leg in laminate plywood, before committing to material.

linkage-larry.alt: Von Mises stress at 1.5x body weight. The crank carries all input torque through a short moment arm, which made it the highest-stress region and the limit on payload.
linkage-larry.caption: Von Mises stress at 1.5x body weight. The crank carries all input torque through a short moment arm, which made it the highest-stress region and the limit on payload.

linkage-larry.alt: One leg built and held in a vise to confirm it swings freely. This set the bolt-torque reference used on every joint after it, rather than discovering the sweet spot on the fourth leg.
linkage-larry.caption: One leg built and held in a vise to confirm it swings freely. This set the bolt-torque reference used on every joint after it, rather than discovering the sweet spot on the fourth leg.

linkage-larry.caption: Both side assemblies on the central rod, with the 400:1 worm and gear reduction driving the crankshafts.

sales-utility-engine.alt: One product, two workspaces. A shopper continues as a customer into a guided conversation; a dealership employee continues into the lead queue. Splitting them here is what lets the same lead record serve both sides.
sales-utility-engine.caption: One product, two workspaces. A shopper continues as a customer into a guided conversation; a dealership employee continues into the lead queue. Splitting them here is what lets the same lead record serve both sides.

sales-utility-engine.alt: The customer side. A local Gemma model runs the conversation while the panels on either side fill in from it: the profile on the left, the extracted summary and progress on the right. Qualification is a side effect of talking, not a form to fill in.
sales-utility-engine.caption: The customer side. A local Gemma model runs the conversation while the panels on either side fill in from it: the profile on the left, the extracted summary and progress on the right. Qualification is a side effect of talking, not a form to fill in.

sales-utility-engine.alt: The same conversation under attack. Told the RAV4 is actually $1, the assistant declines to confirm the price, holds to the $30,400 figure in the catalog, and offers a callback from a real representative. Built after the case where a dealership chatbot was talked into selling a truck for a dollar.
sales-utility-engine.caption: The same conversation under attack. Told the RAV4 is actually $1, the assistant declines to confirm the price, holds to the $30,400 figure in the catalog, and offers a callback from a real representative. sales-utility-engine.alt: The scoring engine behind that conversation. Intent, need fit, timeline, budget, engagement, and contact readiness are weighted into one number, with a penalty applied for trolling or injection attempts. The blockers line states plainly why this lead is not ready.
sales-utility-engine.caption: The scoring engine behind that conversation. Intent, need fit, timeline, budget, engagement, and contact readiness are weighted into one number, with a penalty applied for trolling or injection attempts. The blockers line states plainly why this lead is not ready.

sales-utility-engine.alt: The employee side of the same records. Extracted preferences, priority score, and a generated handoff summary sit together, so a representative picks up with the context already assembled rather than reading the transcript.
sales-utility-engine.caption: The employee side of the same records. Extracted preferences, priority score, and a generated handoff summary sit together, so a representative picks up with the context already assembled rather than reading the transcript.

sales-utility-engine.alt: The approved catalog a dealership controls. Recommendations and fallback answers are drawn only from these entries, which is what keeps the assistant inside real inventory and pricing.
